excerpt: This Report provides an extensive review of the experimental programme of direct detection searches of particle dark matter ... It aims at identifying the virtues, opportunities and challenges associated with the different experimental approaches and search techniques.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); J. Billard, M. Boulay, S. Cebrian, L. Covi et al. (12 authors)
title: Direct Detection of Dark Matter - APPEC Committee Report
